meta_description: D&H Locksmith Nottingham provides 24/7 emergency lockout, lock repair and replacement. Fast response, fair prices. Call now for rapid assistance.
hero_subhead: Locked out of your home or business? D&H arrive in under 30 minutes, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to security upgrades, we handle all your lock and key needs.

services.title: Emergency Lockout
services.desc: Locked out of your home or business? We'll get you back inside fast, without forcing doors or expensive damage. Available 24/7.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Broken or sticking locks? We repair or replace faulty locks and doors quickly, restoring your security and peace of mind.

services.title: Lock Installation
services.desc: New locks for maximum security. We fit high-security cylinders, mortice locks, and modern smart locks to suit your home or business.

services.title: Burglary Damage Repairs
services.desc: Forced entry has damaged your door or locks? We repair and upgrade your security same day to prevent further break-ins.

services.title: Key Cutting
services.desc: Need spare keys cut quickly? We create high-quality keys on-site for homes, businesses, and vehicles in just minutes.

services.title: UPVC & Composite Door Repairs
services.desc: UPVC locks jammed or broken? We repair and replace lock mechanisms without damaging your door frame.

about_pullquote: No one should feel trapped in their own home. That's why we answer at midnight.
about_para_1: D&H Locksmith has served Nottingham for over 15 years, building a reputation for honest, rapid emergency response. We started because we saw too many locksmiths charging inflated prices for simple lockouts. Every call-out is handled by an experienced locksmith who carries the tools to solve most problems on the first visit.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we're transparent with pricing, we don't leave damage in our wake, and we're genuinely available when you need us most. Whether it's 3am on a Sunday or a Friday afternoon, we arrive ready to help. We're proud of our local roots and our reputation across Nottingham.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Customers Say About D&H

reviews.text: Had a nightmare locking myself out on a Sunday morning. Called D&H and they were here in 25 minutes. No drama, no damage to the door, and fair price. Couldn't ask for better service. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: My daughter got locked in the bathroom at 11pm. Called D&H expecting to wait hours but they came out straight away. Friendly bloke, sorted it in minutes. Absolutely recommend them.
reviews.author: Sarah K.

reviews.text: Burglary left my door and lock damaged. D&H came out same day, fixed it properly and even gave me advice on better locks. Professional and honest pricing. Top marks.
reviews.author: James L.
